contract_resolution_notes: Contract resolution priority (highest first): contract_paths (CLI / policy explicit list) -> active_features_path (governance source-of-truth index) -> contract_glob (migration fallback only) -> contract_path (legacy single-feature backward-compat).

active_features.v1.json is the SOURCE-OF-TRUTH for governance gates. Only entries with status=ACTIVE are enforced; DRAFT / INACTIVE / ARCHIVED entries plus extra files matched by contract_glob are NOT brought into the gate scope.

contract_glob is migration / legacy fallback only. Production setups must keep active_features_path populated so DRAFT contracts that still live under contract/features/ cannot leak through and trip unrelated PRs.

active_features.v1.json is validated fail-closed: a missing index file, malformed JSON, duplicate feature_id, unknown status, contract_path traversal, or an ACTIVE entry pointing at a missing contract all become hard errors instead of silent fallbacks.
lane_env_resolution_notes: ADR-0014: lane environment resolution priority (highest first): CLI --env flag -> DELIVERY_LANE_ENV env var -> policy default_lane_env -> baseline ci_contract.default_env.
Pre-prod döneminde lane subset (unit + contract) zorunludur. Cutover (D30) sonrası org-level variable DELIVERY_LANE_ENV=prod ile full set otomatik aktive olur.
Bu policy field cutover'a kadar pre-prod default'ını korur. Cutover PR'ında default_lane_env=prod set edilir + 72h rollback window.
